dedupe_keys.name: intensite du trafic routier de walstat

description: Intensité du trafic routier de WalStat is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IWEPS WalStat. Un véhicule.km = le déplacement d'un véhicule sur la distance d'un km sur le réseau routier de l'entité. L'estimation se fait en concordance avec les chiffres que publiés par le SPFMT( 'Recensement général de la Circulation 2005' Brochure n° 32 et surtout son Complément Brochure n° 37). Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Administration and Public Services, Mobility. Its keywords are mobilité, trafic, routier, statistiques. The portal shows 289 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
